goal: Fixes a bug where BIP157 light clients get disconnected because compact filters aren't ready yet
Improves connectivity for light-client wallets like Neutrino and Kyoto
reviewability: Ready: design converged after months of feedback, current code implements the agreed pause-the-peer approach
An open question about generalizing the pause pattern remains but does not block review
agreement: Positive overall, no unresolved objections remain
mzumsande's objection to handling this at the index level was addressed by moving logic into net_processing (mzumsande)
ajtowns's suggestion to pause the peer's message stream instead of deferring was adopted by the author (ajtowns)
Author confirmed extending the fix to all three cfilter message types after ajtowns raised the question (ajtowns, randomlogin)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes a real spec-compliance bug that gets light-client peers disconnected or banned
Benefit is bounded to BIP157 light-client interoperability rather than core node stability or fund safety
Addresses a concrete linked issue with corroborating reports from real light-client implementations
